info.title: Pathfinding and Map Analysis Tool
info.description: Finds optimal path through game map and counts tiles

post.summary: Find path to treasure or count tiles on the map
post.description: When strategy is smart_loot: finds optimal path collecting all coins and challenges. When strategy is count: counts specified tile type on the stored map (no game_map needed).

parameters.name: game_map
parameters.description: The 2D game map array. Required for pathfinding. NOT needed for counting.

parameters.name: start_pos
parameters.description: Starting position as [row, col] array. Required for pathfinding.

parameters.name: strategy
parameters.description: Strategy to use. Use 'smart_loot' for pathfinding. Use 'count' to count tiles on the map.

parameters.name: count_type
parameters.description: Tile type to count when strategy is 'count'. Examples: 'c7', 'c1+c2', 'c2'. Do NOT pass game_map when counting.

count.description: Number of matching tiles when counting
